title: An amidato divalent ytterbium cluster: synthesis and molecular structure, its reactivity to carbodiimides and application in the guanylation reaction

synthesis.procedure: Under argon (Schlenk/glovebox), a toluene solution of ytterbium amide Yb[N(SiMe3)2]2(TMEDA) (50 mL, 1.22 g, 2.00 mmol) was added in one portion to a stirred toluene solution of HL (20 mL, 1.12 g, 4.00 mmol). The mixture was stirred for 3 h at room temperature, concentrated, and stored at 0 °C to give black crystals of 1 after several days.
synthesis.time: 3 h stirring; crystals after several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk or glovebox under purified argon; amine-elimination
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: concentration of the reaction liquid and storage at 0 °C afforded black crystals

source_locations.location: abstract; Synthesis and molecular structure of [Yb3L6]·2C7H8 (1)

material_class.structural_family: co-crystallized bridged Yb(III) carbene dimer and homoleptic monomeric Yb(III) amidate

synthesis.procedure: A 5 mL THF solution of DIC (0.23 mL, 1.5 mmol) was added dropwise to a THF solution of complex 1 (20 mL, 1.10 g, 0.5 mmol). The mixture was stirred 12 h at room temperature. Solvent was removed in vacuo, the residue was washed with hexane (20 mL, twice), then recrystallized from a minimum of hexane with a few drops of THF. Orange crystals of 2 formed at room temperature over several days. The same product was also obtained from the reaction at 60 °C in THF.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature (also obtained at 60 °C in THF)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed in vacuo; residue washed twice with 20 mL hexane; recrystallized from minimum hexane plus a few drops of THF; orange crystals at room temperature

source_locations.location: abstract; The reaction of complex 1 with DIC; Fig. 2

synthesis.procedure: Method a: A toluene solution of DIC (5 mL containing 0.23 mL, 1.5 mmol) was added to a stirred toluene solution of complex 1 (20 mL, 1.10 g, 0.5 mmol). After 12 h at room temperature the color changed from dark reddish-brown to orange. Evaporation and crystallization from toluene at room temperature gave colorless crystals of 3 after one day. Method b: A toluene solution of complex 2 (20 mL, 0.54 g, 0.2 mmol) was stirred at 90 °C for 12 h; after workup, colorless crystals of 3 were isolated after one day at room temperature.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature (method a); 90 °C (method b); crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: 12 h reaction; crystals after one day
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporation and crystallization in toluene at room temperature afforded colorless crystals 3
synthesis.yield: method a: 0.30 g, 54%; method b: 0.13 g, 59%

synthesis.procedure: Isolated from the same reactions that produce 3. Method a: after isolation of 3, the mother liquor was concentrated and the residue recrystallized from a minimum of hexanes plus a few drops of toluene to give orange crystals of 4 at room temperature over several days. Method b: after isolation of 3 from thermolysis of 2 in toluene at 90 °C for 12 h, orange crystals of 4 separated from the mother liquor at room temperature over several days.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature (method a); 90 °C then room-temperature crystallization (method b)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: after isolation of 3, mother liquor concentrated and recrystallized from hexanes/toluene; orange crystals of 4 at room temperature
synthesis.yield: method a: 0.27 g, 38%; method b: 0.14 g, 37%
